completeness.why: The four midpoint sites pass their raw amount (missing, number or range) to the existing getScheduledAmount, which decides all three cases; runSchedule in schedule-template.ts keeps its own halve-the-rounded-sum copy, which keeps behaviour but was not carried as an explicit variant of the shared definition.

interface.why: Reuses the existing exported getScheduledAmount, only widening its parameter type to accept null/undefined, with no speculative options; the template's different rounding is not made explicit as a parameter, so that inconsistency stays implicit.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline copies were removed and replaced by calls to the existing helper; the remaining template copy is left as it was, not disguised.
